about.title: Architecture
about.description: We are a passionate team of architects and designers creating meaningful spaces for modern living. From concept to completion, we focus on innovative design, smart planning and sustainable solutions that enhance the way people live, work and connect.

process.title: Our
process.description: From initial consultation to final execution, we follow a streamlined process to deliver exceptional design solutions with precision and care.

steps.title: Visit Project
steps.description: We understand your requirements and visit the site to assess the space and possibilities.

steps.title: Planning Design
steps.description: Our team creates detailed plans and design concepts tailored to your needs.

steps.title: Project Sketch
steps.description: We develop 2D/3D sketches and visualizations to give you a clear view of the final outcome.

steps.title: Start Working
steps.description: Once approved, we begin execution with quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

testimonials.name: Priya Mehta
testimonials.text: From the first meeting they listened carefully and turned our rough ideas into a living room we love. Every material and finish was chosen with care.

testimonials.name: Rahul Sharma
testimonials.text: Our home was just a basic space before, but their design completely transformed it into a beautiful and functional home. The team understood our needs, suggested creative ideas and delivered exactly what we imagined. Very professional, timely and great attention to detail. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Ankit Verma
testimonials.text: Delivered on schedule and within budget. The lighting and woodwork gave our villa a warm, premium feel that guests always comment on.

testimonials.name: Neha Kapoor
testimonials.text: A smooth experience from concept to handover. Smart storage ideas made our compact apartment feel open and elegant.
